comment: Alternate Perspective Civil War Starts - which armour mod each start takes its uniform from.
Each side lists its SOURCES in the order they are tried, top to bottom. The first source that works is the uniform.
A source works when one of its plugins is loaded AND every piece that is not marked optional is found in the game under
the name written here. Otherwise the log (CivilWarStarts.log) says why, and the next source is tried. The last source
names no plugin: it is the game's own gear, so a start never hands out nothing and never needs another mod.
To reorder: move a source block up or down. To switch one off: delete its block. To add a mod: copy a block, change the
plugin file name or names, and the pieces. A piece is {slot, form, name}. 'form' is the plugin's FormID with the load-order
digits left off (the last six hex digits as xEdit shows them, so 05000804 is written 0x000804), 'name' is the item's
name exactly as the game shows it, and 'slot' is a word for the log. Add "optional": true to a piece the uniform can
go without - a mod with no shield works if the shield is optional. The number of pieces is not fixed.
A source with no plugin takes whole FormIDs from the game's own files and does not check the names, because armour mods
that replace the game's gear change those names on purpose.
If this file is missing or has a typo, the mod logs the line and column and uses the lists built into the DLL instead.
A mod that only REPLACES the game's own armour records needs no block: the game's own FormIDs at the bottom of each side
already show its look. Checked by reading each mod's plugin (2026-10-19):
New Legion (Nexus 30468, DIS_Heavy_Legion.esp) and Heavy Legion (22877, HeavyLegion.esp) replace all six Imperial pieces
used below, so the Imperial start wears their Legion set with no entry.
Imperial Armors and Weapons Retexture and other asset-only mods change no record at all.

stormcloak.label: Civil War Guard Armor Replacer
stormcloak.comment: An all-in-one armour plugin whose Windhelm set has FormIDs of its own.

stormcloak.label: Sons of Skyrim
stormcloak.comment: Nexus 68656, version 2.0 and Xtudo's patched copies of it (same plugin). Each hold has its own kit; the Windhelm kit suits the Windhelm war room.

stormcloak.label: Guards Armor Replacer
stormcloak.comment: Nexus 22671, version 5.5a. It also replaces the game's Stormcloak cuirass and helmet, but its own Eastmarch rebel set is a fuller uniform. The 'Minimal ESP' download has no weapon records, so it falls through to the next source.

stormcloak.label: the game's own Stormcloak gear
stormcloak.comment: No plugin: whole FormIDs in Skyrim.esm. The names are for the log only; Guards Armor Replacer and others rename these records on purpose.

imperial.label: the game's own Legion gear
imperial.comment: No plugin: whole FormIDs in Skyrim.esm. New Legion and Heavy Legion replace exactly these six records, so with any of them loaded this IS their Legion set - which is why they have no block of their own.
